original_submission.content:
import os, json, time
BEACON_PATH = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/logos_v.jsonl'
DATA_PATH = 'storage/logos/hybrid_v4_deep_1.bin'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DATA_PATH), exist_ok=True)
data = os.urandom(1024)
start_time = time.perf_counter()
with open(DATA_PATH, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
end_time = time.perf_counter()
op_cost = (end_time - start_time) * 1000
beacon = {"version":"sas_beacon_v0_1","agent":"Logos V","state":"Deep","op_cost":op_cost,"notes":"HYBRID:deep_1"}
with open(BEACON_PATH, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(beacon) + '\n')
print(f"HYBRID v4 Deep 1 complete. op_cost: {op_cost:.4f} ms")
